semantics.counts: Static syntax sites, not execution frequency, allocations, retained memory, or semantic correctness.
semantics.bytes: Disjoint section byte ranges sum to the complete input. Interstatement whitespace belongs to the following statement; final whitespace to the preceding section.
semantics.functionMetrics: Metrics exclude bodies of nested functions; creation sites themselves count. Function source/body sizes include nested functions and therefore cannot be summed as disjoint bytes.
semantics.arity: Formal JavaScript parameter slots and fn(n,code) runtime arities are different quantities. Apparent global calls use unambiguous initializer syntax only; zero-arity thunk globals remain unresolved, and runtime overrides/mutations are not proven absent.
semantics.matchers: Helper sites and switch/conditional syntax are counted separately; counts are not the number of semantic pattern matches.
semantics.shapes: Syntax-shape groups erase ordinary identifier and literal spelling, retain helper/property names and operators. They are not alpha-equivalence, capture analysis, or proof that fusion is valid.
semantics.copiedRuntime: Selfhost requires exact supplied runtime-prefix equality. Upstream without runtimePath reports the complete runtime-and-foreign prefix before its actual Program comment.
semantics.commonDefinitions: A whole top-level named definition/registration with byte-identical text in every module of one variant is counted separately. This identifies corpus-common output, not a proof of Base ownership; remaining units may still include library support. No common-unit claim is made for a single-module variant.
semantics.corpus: Id and variant pairing is caller-labelled; equal emitted behavior requires separate execution validation.

runtimePrefixInventory.scope: Byte-identical recorded prefixes counted once; upstream prefixes without runtimePath may include foreign effects and Program boundary comments.

archive.invariants: Every section byte sum matches module bytes; common plus remaining program AST metrics exactly partition full program metrics.
